_about: Catania-Sicilia, 10 Oct 2026 — the four readings (GOLD6 §8). Every fact comes from the guide's own cards and venue records (checked 4–5 Oct 2026); places the guide could not confirm say so.

onenight.title: Une nuit
onenight.kicker: One night ashore · pick the quarter you are berthed nearest · walking order
onenight.lede: Catania eats standing, and late: aperitivo at seven, dinner by half past eight, jazz at ten, and the lanes off Piazza Teatro Massimo still full at two. Each quarter below is one evening, in the order you walk it. Every name opens its full card; hours were read on 4–5 October 2026, and the bars we could not confirm on their own sites say so.
onenight.door_en: Crew ashore for one evening: a plan for each quarter — the vermouth, the table, the cocktail, the kiosk, in walking order.
onenight.door_note: La petite table · le vermouth · le jazz · le seltz

quarters.name: Teatro Massimo · Gemmellaro to Via Umberto
quarters.line: The Catania night in four stops, about a kilometre end to end.

steps.name: Vermut
steps.text: Via Gemmellaro 39: a house vermouth on ice and a board of Sicilian salumi, standing in the lane with everyone else. Crowded; its 2026 trading is not confirmed on an own site.

steps.name: Materia | Spazio Cucina
steps.text: By the opera house, at Via Teatro Massimo 29: the onion charred on the grill with tuma persa cream, then the salt cod salad. Open seven nights, 19:00–23:00; book by phone.

steps.name: Oliva.co Cocktail Society
steps.text: Down the steps of Via delle Scale, off Via Umberto: a Negroni built on a Sicilian amaro. Daily 18:00–02:00 per italia.it; not confirmed on an own site. Walk in.

steps.name: Chiosco Giammona
steps.text: Along Via Umberto to the kiosks of Piazza Umberto: a seltz limone e sale at the counter, mandarino al limone if the salt is too sharp. Hours not confirmed for 2026.

quarters.after: Or a set at the [[venue:monk-jazz-club|Monk Jazz Club]] in Palazzo Scammacca del Murgo: the autumn season starts on 9–10 October; book, sets sell out. The guide's own route is [[card:The Catania night: Gemmellaro to Montesano|the Gemmellaro to Montesano walk]].

quarters.name: Via Crociferi · down to Piazza Duomo
quarters.line: Baroque stone lit after dark, a glass of Etna, a starred table, the elephant.

steps.name: Via Crociferi, after dark
steps.text: Walk in under the [[card:The nuns' bridge on Via Crociferi|nuns' bridge]] of 1704: after dark the stone is lit and the street empties. Churches keep irregular hours; the street is free.

steps.name: Nelson Sicily
steps.text: Etna and Vittoria by the glass with local cheese, under an archway on the same street. The address comes from a natural-wine listing: confirm it is open before you count on it.

steps.name: Coria
steps.text: The one-star at Via Prefettura 21, in the historic centre: the almond-filled bottone, then the lamb 'impanatigghia'. Hours are not on our card: book by phone, +39 095 286 4291.

steps.name: Piazza Duomo and 'u Liotru
steps.text: Finish at the lava elephant of 1736, where every Catania walk starts or ends. Free.

quarters.after: Cheaper: the Bib Gourmand at [[venue:me-cumpari-turiddu|Me Cumpari Turiddu]], Piazza Turi Ferro 36, whose bar runs from 11:30 into the night; book ahead.

quarters.name: Castello Ursino · Via Plebiscito
quarters.line: The end of the 1669 lava, then the horse grills on the pavement.

steps.name: The lava at Castello Ursino
steps.ref: card:1669: when the lava reached Catania
steps.text: Piazza Federico di Svevia: put your hand on the 1669 flow at the castle's base. Free outside; the museum is closed for works until early 2027.

steps.name: Arrusti e mancia on Via Plebiscito
steps.text: After eight the butchers put grills on the pavement: horse meatballs, then a sliced steak with lemon, on a plastic chair. Walk in; cash helps; no prices verified.

quarters.after: A thin quarter for anything after dinner: walk or take a taxi back to Via Umberto for [[venue:oliva-co-cocktail-society|Oliva.co]]. If you will not sit at a horse grill, the arancino 'Il Plebiscito' at [[venue:canusciuti|Canusciuti]] folds the same meat into rice; its hours are not on our card.

quarters.name: Aci Trezza · the Cyclops coast
quarters.line: Not walkable: a taxi or the bus north, 20–30 minutes, for the rocks at sunset and a fish dinner facing them.

steps.name: The harbour and the Faraglioni
steps.text: The painted boats facing the basalt stacks of Verga's I Malavoglia, toward sunset. The Casa del Nespolo museum is by San Giovanni church.

steps.name: Faraglioni Restaurant
steps.text: Across the road from the rocks, in the Grand Hotel Faraglioni: MICHELIN-listed fish, vegetarian plates too. Hours are not on our card: book ahead by phone, +39 095 419 2065. Taxi back.

getaway.title: Le week-end
getaway.door_en: Friday night to Sunday afternoon: granita at the counter, the Pescheria on Saturday, a baroque street, the honey town under the volcano.
getaway.door_note: La granita · la Pescheria · le baroque · la montagne
getaway.kicker: The getaway weekend · Friday night to Sunday afternoon
getaway.lede: The coast sells Etna as a coach ride to 1,900 m and an hour among the souvenir shops. The real thing is closer to the ground: almond granita and a brioche at the counter; the Pescheria singing its prices on Saturday morning, because it shuts on Sunday; a baroque street under a nuns' bridge; a tasting of the Milo white on the slope; the honey town under the Valle del Bove on a Sunday. Every stop below is already in this guide and was checked on 4–5 October 2026; where we could not confirm a place, the stop says so. This reading puts them in order and tells you what to book before you fly.
book: [[venue:osteria-antica-marina|Osteria Antica Marina]] — Saturday lunch in the market; reservation recommended, +39 095 348 197.
[[venue:benanti|Benanti]] — the Saturday tasting at visit.benanti.it; harvest weeks in September and October fill first.
[[venue:monk-jazz-club|Monk Jazz Club]] — if there is a Saturday set: prenotazioni@monkjazzclub.it or +39 375 524 9597; sets sell out.
[[venue:da-rinuccio|Da Rinuccio]] — Sunday lunch at Milo, by phone: +39 345 388 3542.

days.label: Friday
days.title: The night lanes off the opera

stops.name: A vermouth in the street at Vermut
stops.text: Before Aperol, the Sicilian aperitivo was vermouth. Take a house vermouth on ice and a board of Sicilian salumi, and drink it standing in the lane when the tables run out, as everyone does.
stops.meta: Via Gemmellaro 39 · best 19:00–21:00 · crowded; 2026 trading not confirmed on an own site

stops.name: Dinner at Materia, by the Teatro Massimo
stops.text: Shared tables and a wall of jars beside the opera house. Start with the farmer's plates, as MICHELIN says: the onion charred on the grill with dry-cured black olives and tuma persa cream, then the salt cod salad.
stops.meta: Via Teatro Massimo 29 · daily 19:00–23:00 (own site, 5 Oct 2026) · €€ · +39 095 1693 1045

stops.name: Down the steps to Oliva.co
stops.text: A cocktail room at the bottom of a stepped alley off Via Umberto, with a back bar deep in mezcal, rhum agricole and Sicilian amari. Ask for the Negroni built on a Sicilian amaro.
stops.meta: Via delle Scale 3 · daily 18:00–02:00 (italia.it, 4 Oct 2026; not on an own site) · €€ · walk in

stops.name: Seltz limone e sale at Chiosco Giammona
stops.text: On to Piazza Umberto, the square of kiosks: a lemon squeezed into the glass, a pinch of salt, soda from a high-pressure siphon. The family has mixed it since 1949.
stops.meta: Piazza Umberto · after sunset · a euro or two (not verified) · hours not confirmed for 2026

stops.name: Granita and brioche at Savia
stops.text: Almond granita and a warm brioche col tuppo: tear the tuppo off first and drag it through the granita. Stand at the counter inside; it is faster than the tables outside.
stops.meta: Via Etnea at Via Umberto, opposite Villa Bellini · go before 9:30 · € · no booking; hours not on our card

stops.name: Down Via Etnea to the Pescheria
stops.text: Walk down Via Etnea, about 1.5 km on basalt slabs, to the elephant in [[card:Piazza Duomo, Catania and 'u Liotru|Piazza Duomo]], then down the steps behind the Amenano fountain. Vendors sing their prices over the marble slabs; in October look for lampuga, the autumn dorado.
stops.meta: Monday to Saturday, about 7:00–13:30; closed Sunday · before 9:00 for choice, 10:00–12:00 is the crush

stops.name: Via Crociferi and the Benedictine monastery
stops.text: Walk in under the nuns' bridge and up [[card:Via Crociferi|Via Crociferi]], two hundred metres of baroque convents, then on to San Nicolò l'Arena, whose monks stopped the 1669 lava at their garden wall. The guided visit goes down to the sixteenth-century basement and the lava under the gardens.
stops.meta: Piazza Dante 32 · tours on the hour, about 9:00–17:00 (older listings; confirm) · about 1h15

stops.name: Lunch in the market at Osteria Antica Marina
stops.text: Back in the Pescheria lanes, the sit-down fish osteria of the market since 1996: the crudo of the day and a fritto misto, from the stalls outside. Loud and quick, not a quiet room.
stops.meta: Via Pardo 29 · daily 12:30–15:00 and 19:30–23:00 (own site, 4 Oct 2026) · €€ · reservation recommended

stops.name: A tasting at Benanti, on the slope
stops.text: Twenty minutes up to Viagrande, to the estate that put modern Etna Bianco on export lists. Taste Pietra Marina, the Carricante from Milo, beside the contrada reds. Ask for an afternoon slot when you book, and let someone else drive.
stops.meta: Via Giuseppe Garibaldi 361, Viagrande · every day except Monday, by reservation · reported EUR 90–220 a head (third-party guide; confirm at booking)

stops.name: Dinner at Me Cumpari Turiddu
stops.text: A MICHELIN Bib Gourmand and a Slow Food Chiocciola in one old-Sicily dining room: the safest traditional Catanese table in the centre. There is a cheaper bistro list beside the main menu, and a shop to buy the cheese you just ate.
stops.meta: Piazza Turi Ferro 36 · €€ · book ahead, +39 095 715 0142 · hours not on our card

stops.name: A set at the Monk, if there is one
stops.text: Catania's jazz club, ten years old in 2026, in Palazzo Scammacca del Murgo. Each act usually plays two nights; the autumn season starts on 9–10 October. If nothing is on, walk [[card:Via Crociferi|Via Crociferi]] after dark instead, when the stone is lit and the street empties.
stops.meta: Autumn 2026 dates after the opening not read · season pass EUR 120; single tickets not seen · book, sets sell out

days.label: Sunday
days.title: The honey town under the volcano

stops.name: Zafferana on an October Sunday
stops.text: About 35 minutes by car up the east flank, Zafferana fills every Sunday in October with honey, apples, mushrooms, chestnuts and preserves. The last Sunday is usually mushrooms and chestnuts. Outside October, buy honey from a producer in the town.
stops.meta: Centro storico, Zafferana Etnea · Sundays 11, 18 and 25 October 2026 · free · arrive before 10:00

stops.name: The rim of the Valle del Bove
stops.text: From the Belvedere above Milo-Fornazzo the ground falls away into a black horseshoe five by seven kilometres, the valley most modern lava runs into. Look from the rim only: the upper valley is Summit Zone, guides only, and the volcano has been erupting again since 24 September.
stops.meta: Morning, before the cloud · loose scoria · bring a wind layer and water · check ct.ingv.it the evening before

stops.name: Lunch at Da Rinuccio, facing the mountain
stops.text: A family restaurant on the Mareneve road at Milo, with a glassed-in veranda facing 'a muntagna. Fresh pasta with mushrooms, grilled meats, a wine list that stays mostly in the province. Then down to Catania and home.
stops.meta: Via Mareneve 5, Milo · lunch · €€ · +39 345 388 3542 · hours not on our card

more.title: If you have only one evening
more.text: A vermouth in the lane at [[venue:vermut|Vermut]] at seven, dinner at [[venue:sapio|Sapio]] (Tuesday to Sunday, 19:30–23:30; come by taxi), then down the steps to [[venue:oliva-co-cocktail-society|Oliva.co]], open to two. That is the Catania night in four hours.

more.title: The grand night instead
more.text: Swap Saturday's osteria for a star. [[venue:sapio|Sapio]] is the most complete modern restaurant in the city: ask for the cellar table or the chef's table in the kitchen; closed Monday, dinner to 23:30, parking hard. [[venue:coria|Coria]], the one-star that moved from Caltagirone in 2024, is the most tradition-literate: the lamb 'impanatigghia' (book; hours not on our card). For fish, [[venue:angio-macelleria-di-mare|Angiò-Macelleria di Mare]] ages and cures it like meat, into octopus mortadella and squid lardo (book ahead).

more.title: Or a night of music
more.text: The [[card:Bellini's Catania|Teatro Massimo Bellini]] opened in 1890 with Norma; its opera and concert season runs autumn to spring (programme on teatromassimobellini.it), and [[venue:materia-spazio-cucina|Materia]], at Via Teatro Massimo 29, works before the performance. The [[card:★ Marionettistica Fratelli Napoli, Catania|Fratelli Napoli]] puppets play the Orlando cycle, but we found no October 2026 date (5 Oct).

more.title: This October
items: The [[card:Ottobrata Zafferanese — every Sunday|Ottobrata]] fills Zafferana on Sundays 11, 18 and 25 October; the per-Sunday themes were not published. [[venue:sabir|Sabir]] is in the middle of it: book if you want lunch there on a Sunday.

[[card:Etna's summit is closed to walkers|Etna's summit]]: the inner hazard zone is licensed guides only since 14 August, and the volcano erupted again on 24 September. Check ct.ingv.it before any mountain plan.
[[card:No Bronte pistachio crop this year|No Bronte pistachio crop]]: 2026 is a rest year and the Bronte festival closed on 4 October. The next harvest is 2027.

[[card:Materia — the last-minute table|Materia]] is open seven nights, 19:00–23:00: the first call when a booking falls through. [[card:Sapio — dinner to 23:30|Sapio]] serves dinner Tuesday to Sunday until 23:30, the latest starred kitchen in Catania.
The [[venue:monk-jazz-club|Monk]] opens its autumn season on 9–10 October with Francesco Cafiso and Dino Rubino.

more.title: Where to sleep
more.text: We have judged these places for a meal or a drink, not for a night: we have not priced or stayed in any rooms. The guide's own advice is to sleep around Piazza Duomo or Via Etnea ([[card:Catania|the city card]]), on foot to the market, the opera and the night lanes. The one hotel already in this guide is the Grand Hotel Faraglioni at Aci Trezza, whose dining room is [[venue:faraglioni-restaurant|Faraglioni Restaurant]]: the Cyclops' rocks across the road, and a taxi or bus into the city each evening.

more.title: What we would leave out
more.text: The [[card:Etna 'summit' tours sold from Taormina|'summit' coach tours]]: most stop at 1,900 m among the shops, and the Crateri Silvestri loop now costs EUR 5 for non-Sicilian residents, contested in court. The Castello Ursino museum is closed for works until early 2027: see the lava outside. [[card:Caltagirone: the ceramics town|Caltagirone]] is a full day, not an afternoon. And at Savia, skip the outdoor tables: the counter inside is faster.
